summary: GMC (Group Medical Policy) feature — Iter 150. Ran comprehensive backend pytest suite (16 tests, all passed) covering policy CRUD + duplicate rejection, eligible-employees filter, bulk-add scope logic (auto/project/head_office), member filters, /gmc/summary math, remove/restore (incl. 400 for exited employee restore), Excel + PDF exports, RBAC (sales_executive → 403), and the CRITICAL FnF integration — full exit workflow (create exit → approve all 8 clearance items → compute-fnf → finalise) auto-removes GMC membership with removal_reason mentioning 'exited'. Frontend Playwright E2E on /app/hr/group-medical login-to-flow: page loads, all data-testids present (KPIs, policy cards, filters, buttons), created a new policy via UI, opened Add Members dialog, added a member via checkbox+confirm, verified member row appears, ran remove-with-reason + restore flow, all working. Menu entry (nav-gmc) is present under HR > Compliance.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button> — outer policy card is <button data-testid='gmc-policy-{id}'> and inside it renders Edit/Delete <Button> components (also <button>). React logs 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' hydration warning at line 129/142. Interactive but invalid HTML; can cause click event bubbling issues and hydration mismatches. Fix: change outer element to <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> or move Edit/Delete outside the card button.

action_items: Fix nested <button> in GroupMedical.jsx policy cards (line 129 outer button + line 142 inner Edit button). Recommended: convert outer element to div with role='button' + keyboard handler.
critical_code_review_comments: gmc_router.py PUT /gmc/policies/{pid} accepts full PolicyIn body — a policy_number collision with another existing policy is NOT explicitly checked on update (only on create). If user changes policy_number to one that already exists on another doc, it would silently succeed. Add uniqueness check.
gmc_router.py bulk-add validates coverage_scope only against {'project','head_office'}; unknown values silently fall through to 'auto'. Consider explicit 400.
Frontend GroupMedical.jsx nested button HTML violation (see ui_bugs).
seed_data_creation: Test employees created with emp_code prefix 'TESTGMC-...'. UI created one policy 'UITEST/<timestamp>' during Playwright test — safe to delete via UI/DB if desired. TESTGMC/ prefixed policies clean themselves up in pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter150_gmc.py can be re-run any time — self-contained (creates its own policy + employees, cleans up). Employee POST goes via crud_router /api/employees with validate_employee_compliance — only pass 'permanent' employment_type or valid IDs. FnF flow requires all 8 clearance items approved; super_admin can approve all roles' items.
